items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Charlie Hartman, Trombone... I don't know who this was.

ctx.x: He was clarinet, first clarinet and alto player at the Low State Theatre. Now this, I didn't know these people. Oh, man, Pansy Lane, I didn't know him, Alfred Lane's other. I didn't know them. Believe me, I didn't know them. This, I didn't know Freddie Christian's band. I didn't know them. I didn't know them. This, this is, this is the band that was at the, this is the band that was at the Hollywood Club. Yeah. I don't know how this is taken inside. Pretty much, I'll get a little club. Well, this is, this is…
Is that Rose and Sushant's book? Yeah.

items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: Yeah, I was playing drums. Oh, and Charlie Hartman. Charlie Hartman was playing trombone... This is Louie Primer. Uh-huh. Yeah. Ed Fontana, Charlie Hartman. All these guys are dead.

ctx.x: So in this period, you were still playing drums, didn't it?
Yeah, I was playing drums. Oh, and Charlie Hartman. Charlie Hartman was playing trombone. Yeah. Frank Federico. Do you remember Polké Carrier?
Again, it's a name I've heard people say.
